alt: A living room from the doorway in five colour palettes: olive with cream sofa, charcoal with rust velvet, warm white with tan leather, dusty blue with grey linen, and terracotta with forest green sofa.
text:
five versions, one room. it's not the furniture — it's what happens when the walls decide and everything else listens.

olive to charcoal to warm white. shift the walls and the room reorganizes. same space. different conversation.

material decisions aren't decoration. they're the language everything else speaks.

#colourharmony #paletteshifts #roomthinking #interiorcolour #spacemaking
